notes: flag to pause / activate channel with low engagement

name: R (recency)
description: last purchase date, days since last purchase, recency score
notes: recency score - Binned value (1 = very old, 5 = very recent)

name: F (frequency)
description: total number of purchases, purchase frequency (num of orders / customer lifetime), frequency score
notes: frequency score - Binned value (1 = very few, 5 = very frequent)

name: M (monetary value)
description: total revenue, AOV (total / number of purchases), monetary score

name: RFM score
description: Concatenation of scores (e.g., R=5, F=4, M=5 → “545”)

name: delivery preference
notes: home delivery, click & collect, store pick up

name: spend trend
description: ↑ / ↓ change in spend over last 3 / 6 / 12 months vs. previous period

name: ad interaction trend
description: change in impressions/clicks attributed to the profile

name: category shift
description: movement between categories (e.g., from budget → premium, kids → adult, summer → winter categories)

name: discount usage trend
description: growing reliance on promotions vs. full-price buying

name: return rate trend
description: returns becoming more frequent, stable, or declining
